name: Feishu CLI
description: Feishu channel and tools integration backed by a local Feishu CLI adapter.

interface.description: 通过本地飞书 CLI 适配飞书消息入口、回复和基础工具。

tools.name: feishu_agent
tools.description: Plugin-provided Feishu subagent for all Feishu/Lark CLI tasks.

tools.name: feishu.test_connection
tools.description: Test Feishu CLI availability and plugin configuration.

tools.name: feishu.calendar_list
tools.description: List Feishu/Lark calendars visible to the authorized user.

tools.name: feishu.calendar_agenda
tools.description: View Feishu/Lark calendar agenda for a date range.

tools.name: feishu.send_text_message
tools.description: Send a text message to an allowed Feishu chat or user.

tools.name: feishu.reply_to_current_chat
tools.description: Reply to the current Feishu channel context.

skills.name: feishu-workspace
skills.description: Use Feishu calendar and IM tools safely through OpenAgent policy.

agents.name: 飞书助手
agents.description: 负责飞书 CLI 的所有任务，包括日程、消息、文档、云盘、多维表格、审批等能力；通过受控 lark-cli adapter 执行。
constraints: 优先通过 feishu_agent 委派飞书任务。
不能让主 Agent 自己查 .env 或环境变量来替代插件密钥。
不能绕过 OpenAgent ToolPolicy、approval、logs 和 UI event。

runtimeDependencies.description: Official Lark/Feishu CLI used by the Feishu CLI plugin.
